data.one_liner: A customizable tooltip widget for Flutter with multiple trigger modes and smart positioning
data.what_it_does: WidgetTooltip displays a tooltip over any widget. It supports tap, long press, double tap, hover, and manual triggers, auto‑flipping placement, custom styling, barriers, close buttons, and separate animation timings.
use_when: Need a tooltip that can be shown on tap or hover
Want custom styling or a guided‑tour overlay
Require programmatic control over tooltip visibility
avoid_when: You only need a simple tooltip that appears on long press
You need a global tooltip manager for many widgets
strengths: Highly configurable trigger and dismiss modes
Full styling control including barriers and shadows
weaknesses: No built‑in support for multiple tooltips at once (no group API)
Requires manual placement of the widget in the widget tree
No code generation or hooks integration
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import package
